answer: Bind each identity to one secure enclave that signs a live, unpredictable challenge once per epoch, proving a distinct physical device behind the account. A farmer running a thousand puppets on one machine hits a wall: each clone needs its own enclave, and a mesa of cheap virtual machines cannot fake the hardware signature. The ember is random spot-checks — repeated enclave proofs get revoked — and a sonnet-length delay before full standing stops instant mass minting. Limit: resold devices must be re-verified after transfer.
